item.title: Calmer Packs, Free Bolts
item.description:
Mages' basic bolts are free, packs no longer all come at you at once, and crafting materials come from where you'd expect. The game closes for a short while during the update; the launcher downloads it as soon as it opens again. Thanks for every report: keep them coming through Menu > Report a bug or the Discord.

Highlights

  • Free basic bolts. A staff's or wand's basic bolt costs no MP (was 1).
  • Packs no longer all come at once. Monsters stand in loners and small groups, and only a few of a pack notice you as you walk past: 1 of a group of 3 (was all 3). Hit one standing in a group and its packmates join in; a loner fights alone.
  • See a monster's level before you fight. Monsters near you show their level and name, coloured from grey (far below you) through green, yellow and orange to red (far above). Your target's name turns purple.
  • Bosses can't be fought from safety. Hit a boss from a spot it can't reach and it leaps next to you. Where it can't land, your hits miss and it heals until you come out.
  • New sources for cloth. Scarecrows on Scarecrow Hill near Wheatlow and in Pellow's Practice Yard drop 1-2 Flax, woven into Linen Cloth. Downs Sheep on Hollin Downs drop a Fleece, woven into Wool Cloth, and Raw Mutton to cook.
  • Crafting starts quicker. The first levels of Forging, Woodworking and Tailoring come faster: a Copper bar pays 9 Forging XP (was 6), so a Copper Platebody gives 45 XP (was 30). Every piece of a tier can be made by the level you can wear it: every Iron piece by Forging 20 (the Iron Platebody was 29).

item.title: Monsters Fight Back
item.description:
Monsters are harder to cheese and quests show up on your maps. Thanks to everyone who reported what felt off. Keep the reports coming through Menu > Report a bug.

There's a new launcher. Download it from https://playmythwake.com/download and use it in place of the old one: it shows when the game is under maintenance and has the new look.

Highlights

  • Stronger monsters pay more XP. One-hitting a Lv 1 no longer pays like fighting something your own level.
  • Quest markers. A gold "?" on the minimap and world map shows where each quest goes next.
  • Monsters fight back. Packs hit much harder, and a monster that gives up the chase keeps its wounds.
  • A new look. A barber and a clothier have opened in Tolvadden, with eight new hairstyles.
  • Fish and feast. Fishing has its own net and rod animations, and animals drop meat to cook: six new foods from Cooking 1 to 30.
  • Crafting is a real climb. Forging, Woodworking, Tailoring and Alchemy pay by the materials you use and take several times longer to level.
